import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check actual package.json content
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -10 /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("=== server/package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -10 /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("\n=== root package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
